scripts.verify: biome check . && bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit && bun run build
scripts.muse: bun run --cwd packages/muse-core build >/dev/null && bun packages/muse-cli/src/cli.ts
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/muse-core build && bun run --cwd packages/muse-cli build && bun run --cwd packages/muse-mcp build
scripts.pack:check: for p in muse-core muse-cli muse-mcp; do (cd packages/$p && npm pack --dry-run); done
scripts.publish:all: bun run verify && for p in muse-core muse-cli muse-mcp; do (cd packages/$p && npm publish --access public --auth-type=web); done
